name: fresh-deps
description: Highlights dependencies that have newer versions available, inline in your manifest files.

freshDeps.useLockfiles.description: Use unambiguous versions from adjacent lockfiles as update and audit baselines. Does not inspect installed packages.

freshDeps.audit.provider.description: Audit provider. OSV sends public package names and checked versions to api.osv.dev when auditing is enabled.

freshDeps.runtimeVersions.description: Runtime versions for compatible-release hints, keyed by ecosystem: python, npm, dart, rust. For example {"python": "3.11.0", "npm": "20.0.0"}.

freshDeps.enabled.description: Show inline hints for dependencies that have newer versions.

freshDeps.cacheDurationMinutes.description: How long resolved versions are cached before the registry is queried again.

freshDeps.audit.enabled.description: Show warnings using the selected audit provider. Sends package names and checked versions to the provider. Checks declaration baselines or optional lockfile selections, not installed or transitive dependencies.

freshDeps.concurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel registry requests.

freshDeps.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single registry request, in milliseconds.

freshDeps.showSatisfyingUpdates.description: Show the newest update within the current major before a newer major, including exact pins. Also report the newest in-range version when the latest is outside the declared range.

freshDeps.includePrerelease.description: Consider prerelease versions (for example 2.0.0-beta.1) as updates.

freshDeps.ansible.enabled.description: Check Galaxy collections and role pins, including explicit compatible HTTPS collection sources. Ansible configuration files are not read.

freshDeps.bazel.enabled.description: Check Bzlmod dependencies, including literal local includes and HTTPS registry flags in .bazelrc.

freshDeps.vcpkg.enabled.description: Check vcpkg minimums, overrides, and baseline selections in builtin, filesystem, or GitHub-hosted Git registries, including port revisions.

freshDeps.docker.enabled.description: Check versioned Docker Hub and HTTPS OCI images, preserving tag precision and variants. Also checks tag-plus-digest references.

freshDeps.helm.enabled.description: Check Chart.yaml dependencies using explicit HTTPS chart indexes or OCI repositories.

freshDeps.swift.enabled.description: Check literal Swift packages from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or configured Swift registries.

freshDeps.conan.enabled.description: Check Conan versions and recipe revisions using configured Conan 2 remotes or the Conan Center recipe index.

freshDeps.scala.enabled.description: Check literal sbt Maven coordinates, Scala cross-version dependencies, and configured platform suffixes.

freshDeps.scala.repositories.description: Ordered Maven repositories for sbt. Build-script resolvers are not evaluated.

freshDeps.scala.scalaBinaryVersion.description: Scala binary version for cross-built libraries and sbt plugins. Empty infers literal library versions but skips plugin declarations.

freshDeps.scala.sbtBinaryVersion.description: sbt binary version used for plugin artifacts, for example 1.0. Both binary-version settings must be set to check addSbtPlugin declarations.

freshDeps.scala.platformSuffix.description: Platform binary suffix for sbt %%% dependencies, such as sjs1 or native0.5. Empty skips platform-dependent declarations.

freshDeps.conda.enabled.description: Check Conda requirements from named, labelled, HTTPS, or defaults channels, and nested pip requirements.

freshDeps.conda.subdir.description: Conda target subdirectory, for example linux-64 or osx-arm64. Empty uses the extension host platform. noarch packages are included.

freshDeps.clojure.enabled.description: Check literal Maven dependencies in deps.edn and project.clj.

freshDeps.clojure.repositories.description: Default Maven repositories for Clojure. Literal :mvn/repos entries select project sources.

freshDeps.npm.enabled.description: Check npm dependencies, tool pins, overrides, resolutions, and pnpm/Yarn catalogs.

freshDeps.deno.enabled.description: Check npm and JSR imports in Deno configs, conventional import maps, and referenced local import maps.

freshDeps.githubActions.enabled.description: Check action tags, verified SHA release comments, runtime setup inputs, literal matrices, and local version files.

freshDeps.npm.registry.description: npm registry URL. Leave empty to read it from .npmrc, falling back to https://registry.npmjs.org.

freshDeps.npm.sections.description: package.json sections to inspect, including volta, packageManager, overrides, and resolutions.

freshDeps.go.enabled.description: Check Go modules and runtime directives in go.mod and go.work.

freshDeps.go.proxy.description: Go module proxy URL. Leave empty to read GOPROXY, falling back to https://proxy.golang.org.

freshDeps.go.includeIndirect.description: Also check modules marked as // indirect.

freshDeps.go.checkMajorVersions.description: Probe for newer major versions (/v2, /v3, ...) of Go modules.

freshDeps.python.enabled.description: Check Python dependencies in project manifests, requirements files, and PEP 723 script metadata.

freshDeps.python.indexUrl.description: Python package index URL. Leave empty to read PIP_INDEX_URL, UV_INDEX_URL or pip's configuration, falling back to https://pypi.org/simple.

freshDeps.rust.enabled.description: Check Rust crates, inherited workspace requirements, and configured HTTPS sparse registries.

freshDeps.dotnet.enabled.description: Check NuGet dependencies and dotnet-tools.json tool pins, plus global.json SDK pins using .NET release metadata.

freshDeps.dotnet.indexUrl.description: NuGet V3 service index URL. Leave empty to use https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json.

freshDeps.java.enabled.description: Check Maven dependencies, parents, plugins, and extensions in pom.xml.

freshDeps.php.enabled.description: Check Composer dependencies using Packagist or explicit Composer repositories.

freshDeps.dart.enabled.description: Check Dart and Flutter dependencies and overrides using public or explicit HTTPS hosted registries.

freshDeps.gradle.enabled.description: Check Gradle catalogs, literal build/settings declarations, and wrapper versions.

freshDeps.gradle.repositories.description: Maven repositories for Gradle catalogs and build scripts, checked in order until a package is found. Build-script repository declarations are not read.

freshDeps.java.repository.description: Maven repository URL. Leave empty to use https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2.

freshDeps.ruby.enabled.description: Check Gemfile and source-resolvable gemspec dependencies using RubyGems-compatible sources.

freshDeps.terraform.enabled.description: Check Terraform and OpenTofu providers and registry modules in *.tf and *.tofu files, and GitHub-hosted TFLint plugins in .tflint.hcl.

freshDeps.terraform.defaultRegistry.description: Registry for provider and module sources without a host. Empty uses OpenTofu for *.tofu files and Terraform for *.tf files.

freshDeps.elixir.enabled.description: Check Mix dependencies in mix.exs using public Hex.

colors.description: Colour of the leading comment token on an inline hint.
Inline hint colour for major updates — the ones that need a range bump or a new import path.
Inline hint colour for minor updates.
Inline hint colour for patch updates.
Inline hint colour for prerelease updates.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
